blocks.x: Well, on that note, we’re looking forward to the concert tonight, and thanks for sharing your thoughts with us.
My pleasure, Monk, thanks for having me.
On behalf of the Hamilton Jazz Archive, I’d like to thank Warren Vache for his time, and we’ll see you tonight.
Good. I’ll go home and practice.
That’s it, you got it. © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
